strings.%s 님께서 오신 걸 보면 프뉴마에서 날아간 정령이 잘 찾아간 것 같네요: Since you've come, %s, the spirit sent from Pneuma must have found you safely.
strings.이번에 오실 때도 괜찮으셨나요? 전에도 말씀드렸지만, 온 몸이 부서질듯이: Were you all right on the way this time too? As I mentioned before, no pain as though your body were breaking apart, or fever as though you might vanish...?
I heard you visited Aie Island after coming to Pneuma.
So word spread because I met Hayden.
strings.모험가님께서 헤이든을 구해주시면서 이곳의 정령들이 아이에 섬에도 닿을 수: By rescuing Hayden, you allowed the spirits here to reach Aie Island too.
strings.아니에요. 아, 맞다. 아르케, 무슨 일로 불렀어요?: It was nothing. Oh, right. Arche, why did you call me?
strings.마음 같아선 제가 아이에 섬에 가서 헤이든을 돕고 싶은데…. 저는 이곳을: I would love to go to Aie Island and help Hayden myself... But I cannot leave this place, so I'd like to ask for your help.
strings.마녀의 저주로 아이에 섬에 있던 정령들이 떠나거나 소멸했어요. 그래서 아: The witch's curse drove away or destroyed the spirits on Aie Island. The magic flowing through the island may have become somewhat contaminated.
strings.프뉴마의 정령들이 가서 정화 작업을 할 예정이지만, 그 전에 해야 할 일: Pneuma's spirits plan to go and purify it, but something must be done first.
strings.아이에 섬을 흔들고 있던 저주의 결을 파악해야 해요. 이곳에서 무턱대고: We need to understand the nature of the curse that shook Aie Island. If the precious spirits go unprepared, they might vanish before they can do any work.
strings.아이에 섬의 주인이신 분의 물건을 가져다 주시겠어요? 그게 있다면 정령들: Could you bring objects belonging to the island's masters? With those, I think the spirits will be able to work hard and do their best.
strings.그분들의 물건을 가지고 계시면 바로 주셔도 되고, 없으시면 구해서 가져다: If you already have their belongings, you can give them to me now. Otherwise, please obtain them and bring them here.
I will, Arche. I'll bring them right away.
Thank you. You know these feelings aren't a secret, right? Hehe.
There are more than you expected, aren't there? Thank you for gathering them.
(As Arche receives the objects from %s, spirits in the distance recognize them and approach.)
strings.제가 구해온 물건을 정령들이 알아보는 건가요?: Do the spirits recognize the things I brought?
strings.네, 맞아요. 감정을 전달하는 정령들이 이 물건에서 느껴지는 감정을 느끼: Yes. Once the spirits who carry emotions sense the feelings within these objects, that will be enough.
strings.이 물건의 주인께선 강인한 분이신 것 같아요. 저주에 걸렸어도 끝까지 자: Their owners must be strong people. Even under a curse, they held on to the will and heart to remain themselves until the end...
strings.(아르케의 말과 함께 아이에 섬에서 가져온 물건이 허공에 떠오른다. 그리: (At Arche's words, the objects brought from Aie Island rise into the air. Slowly, they turn into something like sand in an hourglass and scatter somewhere in Pneuma.)
Now the spirits will go to Aie Island and begin the purification with Hayden.
strings.인형이 된 그분들의 몸을 되돌릴 수는 없지만, 그래도 섬만은 조금이라도: They cannot restore the bodies of those turned into dolls, but the island itself should return at least a little closer to how it was long ago.
strings.(아르케가 말을 이어가다가 놀란 표정을 짓는다.): (As Arche continues, a surprised expression crosses her face.)
strings.아무것도 아니에요. 갑자기 아이에 섬의 옛날 모습이 떠올라서요. 왜 떠오: It's nothing. An image of Aie Island as it used to be suddenly came to mind. I don't know why...
strings.혹시 부탁 하나만 더 들어주실 수 있나요?: Could I ask one more favor?
strings.아이에 섬이 아닌 네레이스 관문으로 가야 하는 일렉 렙톤이 하나 있는데,: There is an Elec Lepton that needs to go to the Nereis Gateway rather than Aie Island. Could you take it?
That's no trouble. Do I simply bring it along? Ow, that stings. I mean this Lepton. Why does it need to go to the gateway?
It seems someone there needs a spirit's help.
strings.아, 따가! 알았어요. 그러면 렙톤이 반응을 보이는 사람에게 가면 되는: Ow! All right. So I should go to the person the Lepton reacts to? Ow!
strings.그래도 따가우시면 담요같은 걸 드릴게요? 카이로스가 뿜어내는 털로 만든건: If it still stings, would you like a blanket? It's made from fur shed by Kairos. It should be fine if you carry it wrapped up.
Oh, you're right. Then I'll go straight to the Nereis Gateway.
strings.감사해요. 정령들이 %s 님을 참 좋아하는 거 같아요. 정령이 태어날 때: Thank you. The spirits seem very fond of you, %s. Even when a spirit is born...
strings.어, 정령이 태어난다는 건 무슨 말이에요?: Huh? What do you mean, when a spirit is born?
You may learn someday, or I may tell you, but for now it's a secret. I'm sorry.
It's all right. It isn't important right now.
Thank you for helping me keep the secret. Travel safely.
strings.(네레이스 관문에 도착하자 %s의 품안에 있던 렙톤이 눈을 껌벅인다.): (When you reach the Nereis Gateway, the Lepton in %s's arms blinks.)
strings.(렙톤이 그대로 날아올라 에담이 있는 곳을 주시한다.): (The Lepton flies up and stares toward Edam.)
strings.렙톤이 도와주려 한다는 사람이 에담이었나?: Was Edam the person the Lepton wanted to help?
strings.아, 사라져버렸어…. 에담이 맞긴 한가보네. 에담에게 무슨 일이 있는지: Oh, it disappeared... It must be Edam, then. Should I ask him what's wrong?
strings.(네레이스 관문을 이용하는 사람들이 떠난 한적한 시간, 에담이 멍하니 하: (During a quiet moment after the gateway's travelers have left, Edam stares blankly at the sky.)
strings.에담? 무슨 생각 하고 있어요?: Edam? What are you thinking about?
Just thinking... No. Ever since that incident, this happens sometimes. I occasionally feel blank and anxious.
strings.그렇군요. 괜찮은 건가요?: I see. Are you all right?
It doesn't affect my everyday life, but when it comes to escort or guard duties...
strings.어떻게든 이겨내고 노토스 님과 비요르 님, 그리고 %s 님께 도움이 되야: I need to overcome it somehow and be useful to Notos, Bjor, and you, %s... I'm ashamed to be in this state.
I can already imagine how pathetic my younger sibling would find me. Sigh...
I'm sorry. I didn't mean to burden you with this...
strings.바쁘신데도 신경써주셔서 감사드립니다. 지금 막 %s 님의 숙소를 정리했습: Thank you for your concern when you're so busy. I've just finished preparing your room, %s.
strings.네레이스 관문을 방문하시면 부담없이 저와 노토스님이 근무하는 건물의 2층: Whenever you visit the Nereis Gateway, feel free to come up to the second floor of the building where Notos and I work.
strings.…저기, 방 이름을 바꿔볼 생각 없나요?: ...Have you considered changing the room's name?
strings.폐하께서 방의 이름을 하사하셔서 쉽게 바꾸긴 어려울 것 같습니다. 하지만: His Majesty bestowed that name, so changing it won't be easy. But there is a way...
strings.오, 방법이 있긴 있군요. 어떤 방법이죠?: Oh, so there is a way. What is it?
You could seek an audience with His Majesty and tell him you wish to change it.
strings.저 그냥 편하게 지낼게요. 엄청나게 편해 보이네요. 하여튼 신경써줘서 고: I'll just make myself comfortable. It looks wonderfully comfortable. Anyway, thank you for your care, Edam.
You're welcome. I only did my duty.
strings.하하…. 그러고 보니 에담, 크노소스에 있었죠?: Haha... Come to think of it, Edam, you were in Knossos, weren't you?
strings.네, 크노소스가 제 유격병 생활 마지막 근무지였습니다. 조용하다 못해 적: Yes. Knossos was my final posting as a ranger. It was so quiet it was almost desolate.
strings.이곳으로 와서 사람을 많이 보다 보니까 증상이 조금 더 있는 것 같습니다: Since coming here and seeing so many people, the symptoms seem a little more frequent.
strings.크노소스에선 멍한게 별로 없었다고요?: You didn't feel as blank in Knossos?
strings.탈로스라는 수인에게 마사지를 받았는데, 효과가 있었던 것 같습니다. 본인: A beastfolk called Talos gave me a massage, and it seemed to help. He said his hands were healing potions and demanded that I pick up litter.
strings.쓰레기 줍는 거 좋아하는 탈로스? 그 탈로스 말인가요?: Talos, the one who likes picking up litter? That Talos?
strings.크노소스에서 약간 일이 있었거든요. 재미있는 사람이라고 해야 하나…. 왜: I had a little business in Knossos. He's quite an interesting person... Why do you look so surprised?
strings.보통 수인이라고는 하지만, 따로 사람이라고 부르는 경우가 없어서 놀랐습니: People usually call them beastfolk. I've never heard someone specifically call one a person, so I was surprised. I'm sorry.
strings.에담이 미안한 일은 아니에요. 그러면 그들을 어떻게 불러요?: You don't need to apologize. What do people call them, then?
strings.그냥 '수인' 정도로 언급하곤 합니다. 저도 어릴 때부터 그렇게 인식해서: Just 'beastfolk.' I've thought of them that way since childhood too...
strings.(탈로스는 칼리 족처럼 동물 귀를 가지고 있을 뿐인데, 사람으로 취급을: (Talos merely has animal ears, like the Kali tribe, yet they don't treat him as a person...)
strings.(생각난 김에 크노소스에 가볼까….): (Now that I'm thinking of it, should I visit Knossos...?)
Edam, I think I need to go to Knossos. I remembered something I'd forgotten...
Not at all, Edam. See you later.
strings.(왠지 %s 님이 오시고 멍한 느낌이 줄어든 것 같네…. 뭐지…?): (Somehow, since %s arrived, that blank feeling seems to have eased... Why...?)
strings.뭔가 충격적인데…. 프레이오스의 사람들이 동물귀를 가지고 있는 사람을 저: That's rather shocking... If people in Freios treat those with animal ears like that...
strings.(%s의 앞으로 에담 주위로 맴돌았다 사라진 일렉 렙톤이 모습을 드러낸다: (The Elec Lepton that circled Edam and disappeared reappears before %s.)
If you've finished, go back to Pneuma. I have somewhere to...
strings.…허공에 뭐라고 쓰는 거야? 크. 노. 소. 스. 같. 이. 가?: ...What are you writing in the air? Go. To. Knos. Sos. To. Get. Her?
strings.(그 말과 함께 렙톤이 %s의 곁으로 다가와 붙는다.): (With that, the Lepton approaches and presses close to %s.)
strings.…알았어. 알았어. 가자고. 그런데 아까보다 무거워진 것 같다?: ...All right, all right. Let's go. But you seem heavier than before.
strings.(렙톤이 말을 알아들었는지 시선을 %s에게로 옮긴다.): (As though understanding, the Lepton turns its gaze toward %s.)
strings.자, 잠깐…. 무겁다는 말은 괜히 해본 말이니 신경쓰지 마!! 정령이 무: W-Wait... I was only joking about you being heavy! Don't worry about it! How heavy could a spirit even... Aaaaagh, that stings!!
strings.오늘도 나에게서 뭔가 알아내고 싶어서 온 거야? 쓰레기를 줍는 걸로는 끝: Back to pry something out of me again? Picking up litter won't be enough this...
strings.(탈로스가 %s의 주위를 맴도는 렙톤을 알아보고는 놀란다.): (Talos recognizes the Lepton circling %s and looks surprised.)
A fresh spirit, straight from Pneuma.
A spirit isn't a fish for sale at a market stall.
strings.사실을 그대로 말했을 뿐인데, 무슨 문제 있어?: I only stated the facts. Is there a problem?
strings.(렙톤이 탈로스 위로 올라가 크노소스 주위를 구경하기 시작한다.): (The Lepton rises above Talos and begins looking around Knossos.)
strings.그 정령을 왜 여기로 데리고 온 거야? 정령은 알아서 제 볼일 보러 돌아: Why did you bring that spirit here? Spirits go about their own business... But seeing that it followed you...
Judging by that squashed-Priring face, you really don't know.
It originally had another destination. After that, it just followed me. That's all I know.
strings.그나저나 프리링 같은 표정은 뭐죠?: And what exactly is a Priring face?
strings.뭐, 됐어. 너도 모르고, 나도 모르는 어떤 위대한 존재의 의지가 발현됐: Never mind. Perhaps the will of some great being, unknown to both of us, has manifested.
strings.렙톤, 어떻게 할래?: Lepton, what do you want to do?
strings.(날아다니던 렙톤이 크노소스의 하늘을 바라보다 날개로 보이는 부분으로 어: (The Lepton looks up at Knossos's sky, points somewhere with what seem to be its wings, then flies swiftly deeper into Knossos.)
strings.저 정령, 수인왕에게 갔군. 아무래도 갇혀 있으려면 누군가의 도움이 필요: It went to the Beast King. I suppose someone who's confined needs help from others.
strings.뭐, 어쨌든 그냥 돌아가진 않겠지. 있는 동안엔 크노소스의 생명에게 도움: Well, it won't simply go back. While it's here, it'll help the living things in Knossos. Whatever else may be true, I'm grateful to spirits.
Now, if you're done, go home. I'm going to sleep...
There's something I'd like to ask.
I pulled some weeds and gathered litter on the way up to Knossos.
Maybe something like the magic brooms at the Magic Academy would do...
strings.(마법 빗자루라는 말에 탈로스의 동공이 커진다.): (At the words 'magic broom,' Talos's pupils widen.)
strings.뭐? 마법 빗자루? 설마 빗자루가 살아서 움직이고, 자동으로 청소라도 해: What? A magic broom? Don't tell me the broom moves by itself and cleans automatically?
That's right. I had some trouble with them before...
What? They're using something that wonderful? Damn, I'm jealous...
I'll ask at Xerenis Magic Academy sometime whether I can get one.
I appreciate it, but that still isn't enough.
strings.후우, 저는 이렇게까지 성의를 보였는데 너무 한거 아닌가요?: Sigh. I've shown this much goodwill. Aren't you being unreasonable?
strings.어쩔 수 없어. 그게 지금 내 손 안에 있는 게 아니니까. 그러고 보니: It can't be helped. The broom isn't in my hands right now. By the way, it seems you've met someone connected to a god.
Didn't even have the courage to act directly, so they made an incarnation...
strings.(현신에 대해서 한 마디도 하지 않았는데, 탈로스는 어떻게 알고 있는 거: (I haven't said a word about an incarnation. How does Talos know?)
strings.쓸데없는 생각하지 말고, 그 현신에게 가서 다이달로스가 좋아할 만한 걸: Stop thinking pointless thoughts. Go to that incarnation and ask for something Daedalus would like.
strings.훗, 무슨 생각하는지 알고 있어. 그러니 허튼 일은 하지마. 그냥 그가: Heh. I know what you're thinking. Don't do anything foolish. Just say he's alive.
strings.뭐해? 안 가고? 조심해서 다녀와, 이런 소리라도 해줄까?: What are you doing? Aren't you going? Do you want me to tell you to travel safely?
strings.됐어요. 그건 그렇다 치고, 만약 제가 안 오면 마법 빗자루 같은 걸 구: No need. But if I don't come back, you'll never even see a magic broom.
strings.청소는 저기 있는 바보 유격병들하고 같이 하지 뭐. 너는 네가 믿는 신을: I'll just clean with those idiot rangers over there. Are you really refusing to do something for the god you believe in?
strings.넌 아직 멀었어. 말로 나를 이기려면…. 뭐야? 갔어? 왜 가? 아직: You've got a long way to go before you can beat me with words... What? Gone? Why leave? I wasn't finished.
strings.내가 더 짜증나게 만들었으니까 이긴 건가…?: Did I win because I annoyed you more...?
strings.(극장에 들어서자마자 글라우코스가 %s에게 손과 많은 다리 중 하나를 들: (As soon as you enter the theater, Glaucos greets %s by raising a hand and one of his many legs.)
Hello, Glaucos. That's quite a greeting.
strings.반가운 나머지 인사를 한다는 게 그만 그대를 놀라게 한 것 같군. 미안하: I was so pleased to see you that my greeting seems to have startled you. I'm sorry.
strings.아하하, 저는 괜찮아요. 그런데 뭘 하고 계셨어요?: Ahaha, I'm fine. What were you doing?
strings.극장의 정비를 하고 있었지. 아무래도 한바탕 소란이 지나갔으니 여기저기: Repairing the theater. After all that commotion, quite a few places were damaged.
I'll help too. I'm partly responsible for the damage.
No need. Hayden, Scylla, and the spirits are helping, so it's all right.
I cannot ask the benefactor who saved this island and everyone on it to do hard labor.
strings.(글라우코스가 미소를 지으며 망치를 쥐고 있는 발을 들어보인다.): (Smiling, Glaucos raises a foot holding a hammer.)
strings.아차…. 나도 모르게 이 모습에 익숙해졌나보군. 무대를 수리하는데 너무: Oh dear... I must have grown used to this form without realizing. I was repairing the stage so naturally...
strings.수리하다보니 사람들이 이곳에 와서 내 극을 봤으면 좋겠다는 생각이 자꾸: As I work, I keep wishing people would come here and watch my plays.
Thank you. Once the stage is properly ready, I'll invite you by my authority as director.
Thank you. The thought alone means a lot.
strings.그건 그렇고, 그대가 여기에 온 걸 보면 내게 볼 일이 있는 것 같은데…: By the way, since you've come here, I imagine you have business with me...
strings.개의치 말고 이야기하게. 다시 살아갈 수 있는 기회를 준 은인에게 보답할: Please speak freely. Will you give me a chance to repay the benefactor who gave me another chance at life?
I haven't heard that name in a very long time.
Of course. He was a kind, goodhearted person who followed a god.
strings.(전에는 지금과 같은 성격이 아니었네…? 지금은 왜 그런 거지?): (So he didn't always have his current personality...? Why did he change?)
Something Daedalus would like... Oh, I do have something... It should be all right.
strings.그래서 말인데…. 그대, 잠깐 시간 괜찮은가?: With that in mind... Do you have a moment?
strings.그에게 주려는 물건이 내가 들고 있는 무기지. 내가 항상 쓰는 것과는: The object I intend to give him is a weapon like the one I carry. A different one from my usual weapon.
I'd like to test whether it's still serviceable. I hope you'll help.
Just as we rehearsed together last time, I'd like your help practicing again. To you, it will be sparring... But don't worry. Think of it as a little fun.
Sparring with you, Glaucos... That won't be easy.
I'll tell you about Daedalus once we're finished.
strings.내가 극장 창고에서 그걸 찾고 있을 동안, 그대가 마지막 무대까지 와줬으: While I look for it in the theater's storeroom, please come to the final stage. The storeroom is behind it.
strings.그대, 바다가 보이는 무대 기억나는가?: Do you remember the stage overlooking the sea?
Yes, I remember. I'll meet you there.
Is there something special about that weapon...?
Let's spar with Glaucos first and hear what he has to say.
strings.(대련이 진행되면서 글라우코스의 얼굴에 만족한 것같은 미소가 번진다.): (As the sparring continues, a satisfied smile spreads across Glaucos's face.)
That should be enough. You can put away your weapon.
Phew. I was wondering how long we'd have to keep going.
strings.(글라우코스가 들고 있던 무기를 %s에게 건네준다.): (Glaucos hands %s the weapon he was holding.)
I originally made it as a theatrical prop, but it turned out better than expected.
strings.그렇지? 언젠가 이 섬을 찾았던 여행자가 들고 있었던 것에서 영감을 받아: Isn't it? I made it after being inspired by something a traveler carried when they visited the island.
Before the continent of Freios split apart, so... Hmm...
strings.엄청나게 오래 전인 것 같네요. 아, 대련이 끝나고 말씀해주신다고 하셨죠: That sounds like an awfully long time ago. Oh, you said you'd tell me after we sparred?
Then let me tell you about my connection with Daedalus...
strings.나는 신의 현신으로 태어난 존재지만, 삶을 선물받으면서 조금씩 알 수 있: I was born as a god's incarnation, but after being given life, I gradually learned something. I was an imperfect being, with more things I could not do than things I could.
strings.그런 부족함을 메우고자 많은 일을 하려고 노력했지. 이 경험이 다른 생명: I tried to do many things to make up for those shortcomings. I believed my experiences would help other living beings.
I wanted many visitors to come and enjoy everything on this island. It didn't always work, but even that wasn't so bad.
strings.실수를 바탕으로 나아가면 되니까…. 삶이란 그런 거니까. 그래도 그건 괜: I could learn from my mistakes and move forward... That is life. I could accept that, but...
strings.곁에 있는 생명이 죽어가는 모습을 보는 건 언제나 힘들었지. 곁에서 돌보: Watching the lives beside me fade was always painful. All I could do was care for them...
strings.내 곁에서 사라진 정령과 동물의 수가 몇이었는지, 이제 기억도 나지 않아: I no longer remember how many spirits and animals vanished by my side.
strings.스킬라가 정신을 잃은 채 아이에 섬에 표류했을 때, 금방 일어날 것 같았: When Scylla drifted ashore unconscious on Aie Island, I thought she would wake soon. But at some point, she developed a fierce fever and could not awaken.
strings.오랜 시간 쌓인 경험을 토대로 죽어가는 스킬라를 구하고 싶었지만, 내가: I wanted to use my long experience to save the dying Scylla, but there was nothing I could do. I had become a living being powerless before death.
strings.(신의 현신이 저런 감정으로 생명을 바라보고 있었다니….): (To think a god's incarnation regarded life with such feelings...)
strings.그러던 중, 마력의 소용돌이 사이에 숨겨져 보이지 않던 이 섬에 어떤 형: Then a pair of brothers found this island, hidden from sight among the vortices of magic.
strings.탈로스와 다이달로스. 둘은 마력의 소용돌이를 헤치고 이곳에 도착했네. 내: Talos and Daedalus. They braved those vortices to reach me and seek my advice...
strings.대륙의 패권을 잡으려는 실바리아 왕국과 수인들의 영역인 크리드와의 공존을: I remember them as people working for coexistence between the Silvaria Kingdom, which sought dominance over the continent, and Creed, the beastfolk's territory...
strings.(메디아 님의 말씀에 따르면 지금의 탈로스가 다이달로스고, 동생인 탈로스: (According to Medea, the current Talos is Daedalus, who killed his younger brother Talos and took his form... But a kingdom? Was the empire originally a kingdom?)
strings.고대 수인들이 어떤 이유로 나와 오셀리노의 이름을 적었는지 모르겠지만,: I don't know why the ancient beastfolk recorded my name and Ocellino's, but the brothers sought answers from me.
strings.그는 오래 전 죽지 않았나? 혹시 그대는 그에 대해서도 알고 있나?: Did he not die long ago? Do you know about him as well?
Well... I'll tell you when I have the chance.
strings.그래, 알겠네. 난 형제를 침입자로 오해했지만, 그들에게 적의가 없다는: Very well. I mistook the brothers for intruders at first, but once I realized they meant no harm, we talked.
strings.그들은 신을 따르면서 신의 이름으로 자신들의 일족을 구할 수 없는 것에: They grieved that, though they followed a god, they could not save their people in that god's name.
strings.내가 형제에게 해줄 수 있는 건 많지 않았네. 신의 이야기가 도움이 될: There wasn't much I could offer. I thought stories of the gods might help, so I told them things they did not know about the Twilight era...
strings.의외로 만족한 것 같더군. 그리고 형제는 스킬라의 병이 가라앉을 수 있게: They seemed surprisingly satisfied. Then they made medicine from ingredients they had brought from Knossos to ease Scylla's illness.
strings.스킬라의 열이 내리고 깨어날 수 있는 희망이 생겼어. 기뻤던 나는 형제에: Scylla's fever fell, and there was hope she might awaken. Overjoyed, I tried to give the brothers gifts, but Talos, the younger, said it was unnecessary and even refused what his brother wanted.
That was the weapon you gave me.
strings.그렇지. 어째서 탈로스가 거부했는지 모르겠지만…. 햇살이 따뜻하던 어떤: Exactly. I don't know why Talos refused... One warm, sunny day, they said I had helped them and left in haste.
strings.어떻게 도움이 됐는지는 알 수 없었지만…, 그게 그들의 마지막 모습이었군: I never learned how I had helped... But that was the last I saw of them.
strings.며칠 뒤에 다행히 스킬라가 깨어났고, 헤이든의 설명을 듣고 난 후에 섬에: A few days later, Scylla thankfully awakened. After Hayden explained things, she was able to live with us on the island.
strings.다이달로스에게는 그때 보답을 할 수 있어서 다행이지만, 지금 이게 왜 필: I'm glad I can finally repay Daedalus for that kindness, but I don't know why he needs this now...
strings.그대가 아는 지금의 다이달로스는 예전과는 많이 다른 것 같은데…. 잠깐: The Daedalus you know seems very different from the past... Could you tell me a little about him?
I'll tell you everything I know.
strings.(%s에게서 다이달로스, 지금의 탈로스에 대한 이야기를 들은 글라우코스가: (Glaucos looks shocked after hearing %s's account of Daedalus, now known as Talos.)
Give the weapon back to me for a moment. I'll return it shortly.
strings.(글라우코스가 다른 손에 들고 있던 무기와 받아든 무기를 같이 손에 쥔다: (Glaucos holds the returned weapon together with the weapon in his other hand. A holy light briefly appears around them, then fades.)
strings.자, 받게. 나쁜 일에 사용되지 않게 섬의 정기를 불어넣었네. 이걸로 신: Here. Take it. I've infused it with the island's essence so it cannot be used for evil. If he uses it to act against the gods, he will surely regret it...
Then I'll be going. Thank you for your time.
strings.나중에라도 무기 같은 게 필요하다면 날 찾아오게. 먼지 쌓인 창고를 정리: If you ever need a weapon or something similar, come see me. While sorting through the dusty storeroom, I may find something useful to you.
strings.(하하…, 왠지 자주 와야 할 것 같네….): (Haha... I feel like I'll be visiting often...)
strings.탈로스에게 가볼까…. 별 일은 일어나지 않겠지?: Shall I go back to Talos...? Nothing bad will happen, right?
strings.(아무런 반응도 하지 않는 것 같지만, 탈로스의 귀가 평소보다 유난히 힘: (Talos seems unresponsive, but his ears are noticeably more alert than usual.)
You brought it, as promised. Hand it over.
After all the trouble I took, that's what you say... You're not even hiding it now.
What about him? He's already gone. Oh, this is better than I expected.
Glaucos said he was glad to finally repay that old kindness.
strings.알았어. 현신이…. 아니, 처음 만날 때부터 그냥 오래 살고 있던 늙은이: Fine. That incarnation... No, even when we first met, he was just an old man who'd lived a long time.
strings.후후, 다이달로스가 탐을 낼만 했어. 그 현신은 아무것도 아니라 했지만,: Hehe. No wonder Daedalus coveted it. That incarnation said it was nothing, but the truth is...
strings.더 듣고 싶어? 이거 맨 입으로 되겠어?: Want to hear more? You think that comes free?
strings.왜 이야기가 그렇게 흘러 가죠?: Why does the conversation always turn this way?
strings.이번 일로 나같은 인기남에 대한 정보를 더 얻었잖아. 시덥잖게 화내지 말: You learned more about a popular fellow like me through all this. Don't get upset over nothing.
strings.화를 더 내겠다면 어떻게 할 거죠?: And what if I do get more upset?
strings.지금 당장이라도 실바리아 제국의 마을 하나를…. 악, 따가워!!: Right this instant, I could take a village of the Silvaria Empire and... Ow, that stings!!
strings.뭐요? 마을 하나를 따갑게 만들겠다고요? 아! 렙톤!: What? Make a village sting? Oh! Lepton!
strings.(언제 나타났는지, 일렉 렙톤이 날아와 탈로스에게 다가와 온몸을 비비고: (The Elec Lepton has appeared unnoticed and is rubbing its whole body against Talos.)
strings.싫다면요?: What if I don't want to?
strings.아악, 떼어줘. 떼어달라고!!: Aaagh, get it off! Get it off me!!
strings.렙톤, 좀 더 감정을 실어서 비빌 수 있어?: Lepton, can you put a little more feeling into that rubbing?
strings.(%s의 말에 렙톤의 표정이 느낌표로 변한다. 순간, 잘못된 걸 직감한: (At %s's words, the Lepton's expression turns into an exclamation mark. Sensing disaster, Talos bows his head.)
strings.떼줘!! 네가 원하는 거 하나 이야기해줄게!!: Get it off!! I'll tell you one thing you want to know!!
strings.좋아요, 탈로스. 렙톤, 들었지? 지금은 물러나고 다음부터 사람들 위협하: Good, Talos. Lepton, you heard him? Back off for now. Next time he threatens people, hide here and give him a sting, all right?
strings.지독한 정령에게 걸렸군. 후우, 어쩔 수 없지. 크노소스에게 도움되는 정: What a vicious spirit I've run into. Well, it can't be helped. It's useful to Knossos, so I'll let it slide this once.
A sharp tongue keeps you alive. Ugh...
strings.(렙톤이 탈로스의 얼굴 앞으로 날아와 맴돌기 시작한다.): (The Lepton flies up in front of Talos's face and begins circling.)
strings.알았어, 알았어. 진정해. 적어도 렙톤 앞에선 조용히 할테니까. 그러면: All right, all right. Calm down. I'll at least keep quiet in front of the Lepton. Now I'll give you something. A hint. Just a hint.
strings.엘 아노르에 시끄럽게도 남아있는 오르카의 부하 목소리 기억해?: Remember the voice of Orca's subordinate, still making a racket in Ell Anor?
strings.오르카는 녀석에게 약속했거든. 언젠가 다시 돌아올 거라고. 하지만, 다시: Orca promised him he would return someday. But he never came back. Just like the ancient god who fled.
strings.(말이 끝나자마자 탈로스가 나무를 타고 올라가 빠른 속도로 뛰어간다. 뒤: (As soon as he finishes, Talos climbs a tree and bounds away. You try to follow, but cannot hope to catch someone who knows Knossos so thoroughly.)
strings.오르카의 부하? …. 갑자기 이름이 생각나지 않는데…. 찾아봐야겠네. 그: Orca's subordinate...? I can't remember his name... I should look into it. But what about him?
Sigh. I'd better head back for now. Talos doesn't seem likely to say anything more.
strings.(그렇게 모험가가 엘 아노르 산길로 돌아나갈 때쯤, 사라졌던 탈로스가 천: (As the adventurer makes the way back to the Ell Anor Mountain Path, Talos slowly descends from the tree where he had vanished.)
strings.협박 내용대로 미끼를 던졌으니까 찾아와서 귀찮게 하지 마. 이 '마녀들': I dangled the bait, just as you threatened me to do. So don't come bothering me again, you 'witches.'
